findings.conclusion: The supplied FET files are grade-labelled variants of a largely shared summary, not evidence of verified Grade 10→11→12 learning progression.

caveats: This compares uploaded Milo Curriculum v1.0 summaries, not complete official CAPS Grade 10, 11 and 12 subject documents.
This does not establish that official CAPS requirements are identical across grades.
The 20 subject entries include aggregated subject groupings and are not necessarily 20 individual learner subject choices.
No exact CAPS document/page provenance or term-level objectives are supplied.
Generic FET assessment notes require current subject-specific policy verification.
Do not invent progression content to make the grades appear different.

treatment.preserveOriginals: Keep immutable source copies and checksums.
treatment.currentRecords: Retain as source summaries, not authoritative grade-specific objectives.
treatment.normalizedModel: Represent shared concepts once where appropriate; maintain distinct grade-specific objective nodes and reviewed progression links.
treatment.enrichment: Populate from current official CAPS documents with title, version/date, page/section and specialist review.
